title: Tool row clock moved to the left, Alt+Shift+T to hide it, and fixed empty /export
highlights: Tool rows now read clock-first: HH:MM:SS on the left, then the tool, then the description, with the duration badge staying on the right
Press Alt+Shift+T (or /tool-row-time) to hide the time badge entirely so the tool description gets the full row width
/export no longer writes an empty viewer when the in-memory session copy has no messages (remote mode); it falls back to the stored transcript on disk
improvements: display.tool_row_time config (default true), JCODE_TOOL_ROW_TIME env override, and the keybindings.tool_row_time_toggle binding keep the new toggle persistent
The duration badge keeps its severity color while the clock stays neutral, and both survive narrow terminal widths
Old .tmp scratch directories older than three days are pruned during housekeeping
